datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on November 09, 2025
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of November 09, 2025, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20251109]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery was processed to detect and delineate actual flood extent across the Philippines resulting from typhoon-induced rainfall as of November 09, 2025. The processed data was delivered as both raster maps (PNG) and vector shapefiles (SHP) to enable spatial analysis and temporal tracking of flood progression.

sources.name: Philippine Space Agency
sources.description: Satellite image processing to detect and map actual flood extent caused by tropical cyclones in the Philippines
